style.name: Warm Bauhaus
style.definition: Clear geometry, tubular frames and functional furniture balanced by tactile neutrals and controlled primary color.
style.materials: chrome tube; black leather; oak; wool; lacquer
style.living: cream rectilinear sofa on tubular chrome base; black leather cantilever lounge chair; round glass coffee table on chrome frame; low oak media cabinet; compact rectangular oak table and four chrome cantilever chairs; white globe light; one red-blue-yellow geometric artwork
style.bed: simple oak queen; cream bedding with mustard throw; black nightstands and spherical opal lamps
style.solarium: black tubular aluminum outdoor lounge chairs with cream mesh cushions; simple metal four-seat dining set
style.implement: Use primary colors in one artwork and a few cushions, keeping the large surfaces quiet.
style.avoid: Avoid filling the room with competing primary-color furniture.
